reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004A8A91 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A8A91-Camera_ResetMatrix_14.cpp at sha256 b2e28464c55b99613377c7d393d03ec4054d420f5fc1db2f053dc492ea0d02b4 (recorded implementation.signature: long double(double arg1, int16_t arg2 @ 0xa) __pure Camera_ResetMatrix_14(void);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_ResetMatrix_14
retail_function.summary: Four blocks 0x4A8A91-0x4A8ACB: read high word [EBP+0xE], mask 0x7FF0, compare 0x7FF0; if not equal load the double at [EBP+8]; else rebuild the 80-bit value on the stack and fld tword; ret with st0.

checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004A8A91 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004A8A91-Camera_ResetMatrix_14.cpp (sha256 b2e28464c55b99613377c7d393d03ec4054d420f5fc1db2f053dc492ea0d02b4). Four blocks 0x4A8A91-0x4A8ACB: read high word [EBP+0xE], mask 0x7FF0, compare 0x7FF0; if not equal load the double at [EBP+8]; else rebuild the 80-bit value on the stack and fld tword; ret with st0.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN long double(double arg1, int16_t arg2 @ 0xa) __pure: the double is at [EBP+8] and the high word at [EBP+0xE] (inside the double slot, not a separate cdecl argument). The candidate long double __fload(double context, short arg2) declares arg2 as a separate cdecl argument at [EBP+0xC], not [EBP+0xE].

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: BN long double(double arg1, int16_t arg2 @ 0xa) __pure: the double is at [EBP+8] and the high word at [EBP+0xE] (inside the double slot, not a separate cdecl argument). The candidate long double __fload(double context, short arg2) declares arg2 as a separate cdecl argument at [EBP+0xC], not [EBP+0xE].

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 4 block(s)/4 edge(s) at 0x004A8A91; radare2 recovers the identical 4 block(s)/4 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 4 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Reads [EBP+8] (low dword), [EBP+0xC] (high dword) and [EBP+0xE] (high word of the same slot); the candidate's short arg2 is at [EBP+0xC] and reads the wrong bytes.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Returns a long double in st0; the candidate returns long double — the class is right but the special-case reconstruction is wrong.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The function rebuilds the x87 tword on the stack for the 0x7FF0 case and returns via st0; the candidate's short/stack model and `return context` do not reproduce the fld tword path.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "long double(double arg1, int16_t arg2 @ 0xa) __pure" at 0x004A8A91; radare2 recovers "fcn.004a8a91 (int32_t arg_8h, int32_t arg_ch, int16_t arg_eh);". Both tools place the entry at 0x004A8A91 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: long double(double arg1, int16_t arg2 @ 0xa) __pure Camera_ResetMatrix_14(void);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
